flashbots.note: Flashbots Protect hides a transaction that was submitted to it. It does not publish that transaction, and watching the Protect endpoint is not an earlier view of someone else's private order. The websocket redirects to an https host. txpool_status is refused. A pending-transaction filter on the HTTP front door is not stable across requests, which is what happens when filters are pinned to one backend. This monitor never calls eth_sendPrivateTransaction.

methodology.large: USDC/USDT/DAI at least 10,000 whole tokens, WETH/wstETH at least 5, WBTC at least 0.5, native ETH at least 5. Not a live price.
methodology.lead_seconds: including block timestamp minus wall-clock time the pending body was first seen. Positive is early. Negative is late.
methodology.not_stored: Raw input, r, s, and v are not written. Transactions are not resubmitted.
methodology.snapshot: Snapshot votes are signed messages stored off-chain at hub.snapshot.org. They are not Ethereum transactions, so a mempool subscription cannot see them.
